huggingface-api.$comment: All requests to the Hugging Face Hub and Inference APIs.

huggingface-read.$comment: Read anything from the Hugging Face APIs: list and search models, datasets, and Spaces, and download their files.

huggingface-write.$comment: Create, update, or delete through the Hugging Face APIs: create repos, upload files, and manage settings.

huggingface-inference.$comment: Run hosted inference through the Hugging Face Inference Providers router (consumes compute/quota).
